_comment: Portable version of configs/gui_species.json, copied into the GUI bundle by scripts/export_gui_bundle.py. Every image source is a plain folder, so the GUI runs on a machine without data/raw or data/yolo. Format: src/detect/species.py.

sources.label: zExtra samples — never seen (unlabelled)
sources.note: **zExtra samples.** A few frames from the one set the model has never seen in any form: excluded from every dataset version, never labelled, never trained on, never evaluated (D-003). There is no ground truth here, so a miss and a correct rejection look identical.

sources.label: val samples — used for tuning (labelled)
sources.note: **val samples.** A few frames of the validation split, with their labels. Validation was used for threshold choice and model selection, so this is the legitimate place to explore what the sliders do.

sources.label: test samples — held out (labelled)
sources.note: **test samples — HELD OUT.** A few frames of the v1 test split, with their labels. The test split was never used for training, tuning, threshold choice or model selection (rule 7); E027 and E001 were each evaluated on it exactly once. Look, but do not tune: keeping a slider value found here is threshold selection on test.

sources.label: Zenodo sk samples — new site, held out (labelled)
sources.note: **Zenodo sk samples — HELD OUT, NEW SITE.** A few frames from the Zenodo sk site (another country and camera setup, D-031), with the Zenodo labels. Never used for training or tuning; only E027 was evaluated on the full set, once. Look, but do not tune.
